Theme

Latin word

aetās

aetās, aetātis f.

noun, third declension

age, time of life; a generation; an age, a time; lifetime; a time of life; a period of life; an age, an era; a time of life, an age

In this lexicon

  • age

    the recommended word · classical · Quint. 1 pr. 6: cujus prīma aetās manifestum jam ingeniī lūmen ostendit; Traupman 269; Traupman 359; Traupman 394

  • generation

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Sen. 31: tertiam jam enim aetātem hominum vidēbat; Hor. Carm. 3.6.46: aetās parentum, pejor avīs

  • life

    also used · classical · Cic. Sen. 70: breve enim tempus aetātis satis longum est ad bene honestēque vīvendum

  • period

    also used · classical · Cic. Sen. 33: suaque cuique partī aetātis tempestīvitās est data; Traupman 77

  • phase

    also used · classical · Cic. Sen. 76: cōnstāns aetās, quae media dīcitur (Lewis & Short, s.v. cōnstāns)
